0022600231.text: The Denver Nuggets (6-4, 1.5 games back of the Northwest lead, 10th in the West) head to New Orleans on a one-game winning streak, while the Pelicans (4-8, 12th in the West) have lost four straight. Denver is without Julian Strawther because of a knee sprain, and New Orleans is missing Yves Missi, who is out with a knee bruise. Denver leads the 2026-27 season series 2-0 after taking all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 104-91 win in New Orleans on October 28, 2026.
